title: docs(forms): the "Current renderer status (2026-08-11)" note says the Console redirects verbatim without substituting `{{record.…}}` tokens; the pinned Console has substituted and URL-escaped them since objectui#4190
body:
Filing gate ① — a `finding`: a published docs page states Console behaviour that is false at the pinned `.objectui-sha`. reach: the docs site's `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx`, section on `submitBehavior: { kind: 'redirect' }`.

## What is wrong

`content/docs/ui/forms.mdx:389` on `origin/main`:

> **Current renderer status (2026-08-11).** The console shipping at the pinned `.objectui-sha` redirects **verbatim** on this value: it does not yet substitute `{{record.…}}` tokens or escape them. … Until it lands, a token would reach the browser literally — so write a plain path unless you are following that issue.

At the pin this repo builds against (`.objectui-sha` = `f0268ad784854568aa58a2aa791f6a7502259186`), the Console substitutes the tokens:
- `apps/console/src/components/submitRedirect.ts` implements the ruling's three points: relative paths only; interpolation only from `{{record.field_name}}`, with each value URL-escaped when the redirect is built; and a verbatim redirect on the resolved path.
- It arrived with objectui#4190 (objectui `a34c0b299`, PR objectui#4992, 2026-08-17). It is already present at the previous pin `a58626c88dc8`, so the note has been false since before the latest bump.

So the page tells authors to avoid a feature that works, and the "until it lands" caveat points at an issue that has landed.

## Where it was met

The `domain:cli` seat 1 declaration `6079439946` (on #6023, for #22437 / PR #22462) records it as "drift … this page's and predates the PR", read in that PR's Acceptance notes and not edited there.

## Done when

- The status note is removed, or restated as what the pinned Console does.
- The section's three rules and the mode-aware default are left as written.
- No other page restates the old "verbatim, no substitution" status; a grep for it is in the PR body.
